# HRnet - Employee Management Application

HRnet is a modern React-based employee management application designed to streamline the creation and management of employee records with an intuitive user interface.

## Features

- **Create Employees**: Add new employee records with comprehensive information
- **Employee Directory**: View and manage all employee records in a centralized location
- **Data Persistence**: Redux state management for reliable data handling
- **Responsive Design**: Fully responsive interface that works on all devices
- **SEO Optimized**: Built with accessibility and search engine optimization in mind

## Pages

- [Create Employee](/employees/create) - Add new employees to the system
- [Employee List](/employees) - View all employees in the database
- [Homepage](/) - Main landing page

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19 with Vite
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit
- **Routing**: React Router DOM
- **UI Components**: React Data Table Component
- **Date/Time**: React DateTime Picker
- **Styling**: CSS3

## Getting Started

To learn more about HRnet and how to use it, visit the main application or explore the employee management features.
